coverage.styleSamples: Opening three narrative/dialogue paragraphs from each current Japanese continuation chapter 81–85; current Japanese standard and working term list.

corrections.before: 死んでもあなたの霊です
corrections.after: 死んで魂になっても、あなたのものです
corrections.reason: Avoid implying the speaker becomes the husband’s own ghost.

corrections.before: 親子三人で後家と父のない娘を騙した
corrections.after: あの一族の男三人で後家と父のない娘を騙した
corrections.reason: The three named men include Jia Lian, not one father and two sons.
比 expresses comparison, unlike the explicit surpassing in 才过.

corrections.before: 潘安より美しくたって
corrections.after: 潘安ほど美しくたって
corrections.reason: Preserve comparison without adding a claim of surpassing.

corrections.before: 炕の縁の下にしゃがませて
corrections.after: 炕の縁のそばにしゃがませて
corrections.reason: The servant is beside the raised platform, not underneath it.
Keep the same physical location clear.

corrections.before: 実の姑である邢の奥さま
corrections.after: 本来の姑である邢の奥さま
corrections.reason: Distinguish the rightful mother-in-law from Wang Furen without suggesting biological parentage.

corrections.before: その立場を鼻にかけたりせず
corrections.after: そのことを気にかけず
corrections.reason: Does not take the relationship to heart, not specifically a claim about boasting.

corrections.before: うちの姑奥さまのお嬢さまで
corrections.after: 賈家から嫁がれたおば奥さまのお嬢さまで
corrections.reason: Japanese 姑 means mother-in-law, whereas 姑太太 here is a married paternal-family aunt.
